title: SOSSessionActivity - Data API
description: Captures information about specific events that occur during an SOS video call, such as when an SOS call begins or ends. This object is available in API version 34.0 and later.

ActivityTime.description: The time at which the activity occurred.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, idLookup, Filter, Sort

SessionId.description: The ID of the SOS session that’s associated with the event.

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Type.description: The kind of activity that occurred.

usage: Use this object to query and manage SOS session activities.
